title: Financial Times examines growing law firm interest in outside capital
summary: Law firms are increasingly exploring outside capital as they face rising costs, greater competition and growing investment needs, including technology and AI. The Financial Times examines the trend and highlights Burford’s role in the evolving market, including its approach to providing patient, long-term capital to support law firms’ growth and strategic priorities. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Law firms are increasingly exploring outside capital as they face rising costs, greater competition and growing investment needs, including technology and AI.


The *Financial Times* examines the trend and highlights Burford’s role in the evolving market, including its approach to providing patient, long-term capital to support law firms’ growth and strategic priorities.


[Read the full article here](https://www.ft.com/content/475d573a-886d-4b75-b07c-f74c38b093f2) .
